name: @forgekitstudio/core-mcp

tools.name: project.info
tools.description: Returns a stable summary of a Godot project: name, godot_version, api_version, modules_count, root_path.

tools.name: project.list_modules
tools.description: Returns every `forgekit_*` module under the project with manifest fields (id, version, license_id, core_min_version, source_repo, enabled).

tools.name: project.list_workspaces
tools.description: Lists every registered workspace, the active workspace id (if any), and the hard MAX_WORKSPACES limit.

tools.name: project.switch
tools.description: Activates the workspace identified by `workspace_id`. Returns the newly active workspace.

tools.name: project.add
tools.description: Registers a new workspace pointing at `project_root` with optional `label`. Auto-activates the workspace when no other is active.

tools.name: project.remove
tools.description: Removes the workspace identified by `workspace_id`. Returns `{removed: true}` on success.

tools.name: project.get_active
tools.description: Returns the currently active workspace, or `{workspace: null}` if none is active.

tools.name: scene.open
tools.description: Opens a scene file in the editor and returns its node count.

tools.name: node.add
tools.description: Adds a new node of the given `type` named `name` under `parent_path` inside `scene_path`. Returns the resolved node path and the matching undo action id.

tools.name: node.set_property
tools.description: Sets `property` on the node at `node_path` to `value`. Returns the previous value alongside the new one and the undo action id.

tools.name: input.simulate_action
tools.description: Synthesizes an `InputEventAction` for `action`. `pressed` toggles the press state and `strength` overrides the analog value.

tools.name: input.simulate_key
tools.description: Synthesizes a keyboard event. `keycode` matches Godot Key enum values. `echo` mirrors Godot key-repeat semantics.

tools.name: input.simulate_mouse_button
tools.description: Synthesizes a mouse button event. `button` matches Godot `MouseButton` enum values.

tools.name: input.simulate_mouse_motion
tools.description: Synthesizes an absolute mouse motion event at `position`, with optional `relative` delta.

tools.name: input.list_actions
tools.description: Returns every InputAction along with its bound events.

tools.name: input.configure_action
tools.description: Configures action `action` with the supplied `events` array and optional `deadzone`. Atomic write to `project.godot`. Other actions are preserved.

tools.name: input.remove_action
tools.description: Removes the InputAction `action` from `project.godot`.

tools.name: profiling.get_performance_monitors
tools.description: Returns the requested Godot `Performance.MONITOR_*` values. When `monitors` is omitted, returns every standard monitor.

tools.name: profiling.get_frame_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate frame statistics over the last `window_frames` rendered frames (default 60).

tools.name: combat.list_hitboxes
tools.description: Returns every active `Hitbox2D` and `Hitbox3D` in the live scene tree. Each entry carries `node_path`, `team`, `damage`, `damage_type`, and `dimension` ("2d" | "3d").

tools.name: crafting.execute
tools.description: Executes the recipe `recipe_id` for the active crafter. Returns a `CraftingResult` discriminated by `status`.

tools.name: crafting.list_recipes
tools.description: Returns every registered recipe. Optional `filter` matches by id prefix or output item.

tools.name: crafting.get_recipe
tools.description: Returns the recipe `recipe_id` as parsed `.tres` fields.

tools.name: crafting.create_recipe
tools.description: Creates a new RecipeResource at `addons/forgekit_rpg/crafting/recipes/<id>.tres`.

tools.name: crafting.update_recipe
tools.description: Patches the existing recipe `id` with the supplied `patch`. Returns applied/previous diffs for undo bookkeeping.

tools.name: crafting.delete_recipe
tools.description: Deletes the recipe `id` from disk.

tools.name: crafting.validate_recipe
tools.description: Validates a recipe (either by stored `id` or inline `fields`) and returns `{ok, errors}`.

tools.name: crafting.simulate_cost
tools.description: Runs `iterations` simulated executions of `recipe_id` and returns the average input/output counts.

tools.name: inventory.add_item
tools.description: Adds `amount` of `item_id` to the active inventory.

tools.name: inventory.remove_item
tools.description: Removes up to `amount` of `item_id`. Returns the actually removed amount and the resulting count.

tools.name: inventory.get_count
tools.description: Returns the current count of `item_id`.

tools.name: inventory.snapshot
tools.description: Returns the full inventory as an ordered list of `{id, count}`.

tools.name: inventory.clear
tools.description: Clears every item from the active inventory.

tools.name: inventory.transfer
tools.description: Transfers `amount` of `item_id` from `from_owner` to `to_owner`.

tools.name: inventory.set_capacity
tools.description: Sets the max capacity (item count) for `owner`.

tools.name: stats.get_stat
tools.description: Returns the base + modified value of `stat_name` for `owner`.

tools.name: effects.apply
tools.description: Applies `effect_id` (or inline `fields`) to `owner`. Returns the instance id used by `effects.remove`.

tools.name: effects.remove
tools.description: Removes the active effect identified by `effect_id` from `owner`.

tools.name: effects.list_active
tools.description: Returns every active effect on `owner`.

tools.name: effects.tick_advance
tools.description: Advances every active effect by `delta_seconds`. Returns the count of ticks that fired and the list of expired effect ids.

tools.name: effects.list_resources
tools.description: Returns every registered StatusEffectResource.

tools.name: effects.create_resource
tools.description: Creates a new StatusEffectResource at `addons/forgekit_rpg/effects/resources/<id>.tres`.

tools.name: effects.validate_resource
tools.description: Validates a StatusEffectResource (either by `id` or inline `fields`).

tools.name: magic.cast
tools.description: Asks `caster` to cast `spell_id` against `target`.

tools.name: magic.list_spells
tools.description: Lists every registered SpellResource.

tools.name: magic.get_spell
tools.description: Returns the SpellResource fields for `spell_id`.

tools.name: magic.create_spell
tools.description: Creates a new SpellResource on disk under `magic/spells/<id>.tres`.

tools.name: magic.update_spell
tools.description: Patches the existing SpellResource `spell_id` with `patch`.

tools.name: magic.delete_spell
tools.description: Deletes the SpellResource `spell_id` from disk.

tools.name: magic.get_cooldowns
tools.description: Returns the active cooldowns for `caster` as `{spell_id: seconds_remaining}`.

tools.name: magic.reset_cooldowns
tools.description: Resets every cooldown for `caster`.

tools.name: equipment.equip
tools.description: Equips `item_id` on `owner`. Returns an `EquipResult`.

tools.name: equipment.unequip
tools.description: Unequips whatever sits in `slot` for `owner`.

tools.name: equipment.get_slot
tools.description: Returns the item currently equipped in `slot` for `owner`.

tools.name: equipment.snapshot
tools.description: Returns the full equipment loadout as `{slot: item_id}`.

tools.name: equipment.list_slots
tools.description: Returns the configured equipment slot names.

tools.name: equipment.configure_slots
tools.description: Replaces the equipment slot list with `slots`.

tools.name: progression.grant_xp
tools.description: Grants `amount` XP to `owner`. Returns the new state plus the list of level-ups triggered (each with `reward_applied`).

tools.name: progression.get_state
tools.description: Returns the current progression state of `owner` (level, total xp, pending stat points).

tools.name: progression.allocate_stat_point
tools.description: Spends `amount` of `owner`'s pending stat points on `stat_name`.

tools.name: progression.reset
tools.description: Resets `owner`'s progression state to level 1, XP 0.

tools.name: progression.list_curves
tools.description: Returns every registered XpCurveResource.

tools.name: progression.get_curve
tools.description: Returns the XpCurveResource fields for `curve_id`.

tools.name: progression.list_rewards
tools.description: Returns every registered LevelUpRewardResource.

tools.name: progression.get_reward
tools.description: Returns the LevelUpRewardResource fields for `reward_id`.

tools.name: enemies.spawn
tools.description: Spawns an enemy of type `enemy_id` at `position`. Returns the spawned instance id and the runtime node path.

tools.name: enemies.list_active
tools.description: Returns every currently active enemy instance.

tools.name: enemies.get_state
tools.description: Returns the runtime state of the enemy instance `instance_id`.

tools.name: enemies.kill
tools.description: Despawns the enemy instance `instance_id`, optionally crediting a killer (XP grant subscribers will see the death event).

tools.name: enemies.list_resources
tools.description: Returns every registered EnemyResource.

tools.name: enemies.get_resource
tools.description: Returns the EnemyResource fields for `enemy_id`.

tools.name: enemies.create_resource
tools.description: Creates a new EnemyResource at `addons/forgekit_rpg/enemies/resources/<id>.tres`.

tools.name: loot.list_tables
tools.description: Returns every registered LootTableResource.

tools.name: loot.get_table
tools.description: Returns the LootTableResource fields for `table_id`.

tools.name: loot.roll
tools.description: Rolls the loot table `table_id` with `seed`. The same `(table_id, seed)` always produces an identical roll.

tools.name: loot.simulate
tools.description: Runs `iterations` loot rolls without committing drops. Returns aggregate drop counts per item id.

tools.name: spawner.start_wave
tools.description: Starts wave `wave_id` on the spawner `spawner_id`.

tools.name: spawner.stop
tools.description: Stops the spawner `spawner_id` and removes pending spawns.

tools.name: spawner.get_state
tools.description: Returns the live state of `spawner_id`: active flag, current wave id, remaining spawn budget.

tools.name: spawner.list_waves
tools.description: Returns every wave configured on `spawner_id`.

tools.name: spawner.get_wave
tools.description: Returns the configuration for `wave_id` on `spawner_id`.

tools.name: chests.open
tools.description: Opens the chest `chest_id`. When `seed` is supplied, the loot roll is fully deterministic.

tools.name: chests.close
tools.description: Closes the chest `chest_id`.

tools.name: chests.is_opened
tools.description: Returns whether the chest `chest_id` is currently open.

tools.name: chests.list_active
tools.description: Returns every chest currently active in the scene.

tools.name: npc.list_npcs
tools.description: Returns every registered NPC.

tools.name: npc.get_npc
tools.description: Returns the NPC fields for `npc_id`.

tools.name: dialog.start
tools.description: Starts the dialog identified by `dialog_id` and returns the first node plus the available choices.

tools.name: dialog.select
tools.description: Advances the dialog runner `runner_id` by selecting `choice_index`.

tools.name: dialog.list_dialogs
tools.description: Lists every registered DialogResource.

tools.name: dialog.get_dialog
tools.description: Returns the DialogResource fields for `dialog_id`.

tools.name: vendor.buy
tools.description: Buyer `buyer` purchases `amount` of `item_id` from `vendor_id`. Returns `{ok, status, cost}` with status in {"ok", "insufficient_gold", "out_of_stock", "item_not_accepted"}.

tools.name: vendor.sell
tools.description: Seller `seller` sells `amount` of `item_id` to `vendor_id`.

tools.name: vendor.list_vendors
tools.description: Returns every registered Vendor.

tools.name: vendor.get_vendor
tools.description: Returns the VendorResource fields for `vendor_id`.

tools.name: vendor.refresh_stock
tools.description: Re-rolls the stock for `vendor_id`. When `seed` is supplied, the restock is deterministic.

tools.name: visualizer.start
tools.description: Starts the in-editor browser visualizer on the requested `port` (default 6030, auto-scan 6030–6039).

tools.name: visualizer.stop
tools.description: Stops the running visualizer.

tools.name: visualizer.render_scene_tree
tools.description: Renders the scene tree as an HTML page (or JSON document) and returns the URL.

tools.name: visualizer.render_module_graph
tools.description: Renders the module dependency graph (forgekit_core / forgekit_rpg) and returns nodes/edges plus the page URL.

tools.name: visualizer.render_event_bus
tools.description: Renders the GameEvents bus signal/subscriber graph as HTML or JSON.

tools.name: assetgen.sprite_from_svg
tools.description: Rasterizes the SVG `svg_source` at `size` (defaults to native viewBox) and writes the PNG to `target_path`.

tools.name: assetgen.atlas_pack
tools.description: Packs every PNG in `source_paths` into a single atlas at `target_path`, optionally clamped to `max_size` per side.

tools.name: assetgen.noise_texture
tools.description: Generates a procedural noise texture and writes it to `target_path`.

tools.name: assetgen.icon_set
tools.description: Renders the SVG at `source_svg` at every size in `sizes` and writes the PNG icons to `target_dir`.

tools.name: healing.suggest_action
tools.description: Reads a `TestReport`, classifies the most likely failure mode and returns the suggested next action plus a target identifier.

tools.name: healing.inspect_failure
tools.description: Inspects a failure either by `report_id` or by raw `failure_message`. Returns the inferred root cause and candidate fix locations.

tools.name: healing.get_retry_count
tools.description: Returns the current retry count for the resource at `resource_path`, plus the hard retry cap.

tools.name: healing.reset_retry_count
tools.description: Resets the retry counter for `resource_path` so the self-healing loop can attempt fixes again.

tools.name: healing.apply_and_retest
tools.description: Applies the supplied `fix` patch and re-runs `test_command`. Returns whether the patch was applied and the new test report.

tools.name: animation.list
tools.description: Returns every animation defined on the AnimationPlayer at `player_path`.

tools.name: animation.play
tools.description: Plays animation `name` on the AnimationPlayer at `player_path`.

tools.name: animation.stop
tools.description: Stops the AnimationPlayer at `player_path`.

tools.name: animation.add_track
tools.description: Adds a new track to `animation_name`. `track_type` mirrors Godot Animation.TYPE_* constants (e.g. "value", "method").

tools.name: animation.insert_keyframe
tools.description: Inserts a keyframe on `track` at `time` with `value`.

tools.name: animation.remove_track
tools.description: Removes the track at `track_index` from `animation_name`.

tools.name: tilemap.set_cell
tools.description: Sets a single cell on `node_path` (TileMapLayer or TileMap) at `coords` to a `source_id` / `atlas_coords` tile.

tools.name: tilemap.get_cell
tools.description: Returns the tile data at `(layer, coords)`.

tools.name: tilemap.fill_rect
tools.description: Fills the rectangle `rect` (Godot Rect2) on `layer` with the specified atlas tile.

tools.name: tilemap.clear_layer
tools.description: Clears every cell on `layer`.

tools.name: tilemap.import_from_json
tools.description: Replaces the tilemap layout from the JSON file at `json_path`.

tools.name: tilemap.export_to_json
tools.description: Exports the current tilemap layout to JSON at `target_path`.

tools.name: theme.create
tools.description: Creates an empty `Theme` resource at `path`.

tools.name: theme.set_default_font
tools.description: Sets the default `Font` of the Theme at `path` to `font_path` with the given pixel `size`.

tools.name: theme.set_color
tools.description: Sets a `Theme` color override for `control_type` and `color_name` to `value` (`#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`).

tools.name: theme.set_stylebox
tools.description: Sets a `StyleBox` override for `control_type`/`stylebox_name` to the StyleBox resource at `stylebox_path`.

tools.name: ui.build_control_tree
tools.description: Materializes a Control tree under the scene at `scene_path` from the declarative `spec` dictionary.

tools.name: ui.apply_layout_preset
tools.description: Applies the named layout preset (e.g. "anchors_full_rect", "center", "top_wide") to the Control at `node_path`.

tools.name: shader.create
tools.description: Creates a new `.gdshader` at `path`, optionally seeded from a `template` (e.g. "spatial" or "canvas_item").

tools.name: shader.validate
tools.description: Compiles shader `source` and returns whether it parses plus any diagnostics.

tools.name: shader.save_with_validation
tools.description: Validates shader `source` and, when valid, writes it to `path`.

tools.name: shader.set_uniform
tools.description: Sets `uniform` on the material at `material_path` to `value`.

tools.name: shader.list_uniforms
tools.description: Lists every uniform declared on the material at `material_path`.

tools.name: shader.convert_visual_to_text
tools.description: Converts the VisualShader at `visual_shader_path` to a textual .gdshader at `target_path`.

tools.name: physics.set_gravity
tools.description: Sets the global gravity vector. Returns the new value and the previous one for undo.

tools.name: physics.get_collision_layer_names
tools.description: Returns the user-friendly names for collision layers 1-32.

tools.name: physics.configure_layer
tools.description: Sets the name and optional collision mask for layer `index` (1-32). Atomic write to `project.godot`.

tools.name: physics.raycast
tools.description: Casts a ray from `from` to `to` and returns the first hit, if any.

tools.name: physics.shape_cast
tools.description: Sweeps `shape` along `motion` starting at `from` and returns every hit along the way.

tools.name: physics.query_point
tools.description: Returns every body overlapping the world point `position`.

tools.name: scene3d.add_mesh_instance
tools.description: Adds a `MeshInstance3D` under `parent_path` referencing the mesh at `mesh_path` with optional initial `transform`.

transform.description: Godot transform serialized as `{origin, basis}` for 3D or `{origin, x, y}` for 2D.

tools.name: scene3d.add_light
tools.description: Adds a 3D light of type `type` ("directional", "omni", "spot") under `parent_path`.

transform.description: Godot transform serialized as `{origin, basis}` for 3D or `{origin, x, y}` for 2D.

tools.name: scene3d.add_camera
tools.description: Adds a `Camera3D` under `parent_path`. When `current` is true, the new camera becomes the active camera.

transform.description: Godot transform serialized as `{origin, basis}` for 3D or `{origin, x, y}` for 2D.

tools.name: scene3d.set_environment
tools.description: Applies the `Environment` resource at `env_path` to the scene.

tools.name: scene3d.bake_lightmap
tools.description: Bakes the `LightmapGI` for the scene at `scene_path` with the requested `quality`.

tools.name: scene3d.import_gltf
tools.description: Imports a glTF asset from `source_path` (filesystem) to `target_path` inside the project.

tools.name: particle.create_gpu
tools.description: Adds a `GPUParticles3D` (or `GPUParticles2D` when the parent is 2D) named `name` under `parent_path`.

tools.name: particle.create_cpu
tools.description: Adds a `CPUParticles3D` (or 2D) named `name` under `parent_path`.

tools.name: particle.set_emission_shape
tools.description: Configures the emission shape on the ParticleProcessMaterial at `material_path`. `shape` is a Godot enum string (e.g. "sphere").

tools.name: particle.preview_in_editor
tools.description: Plays the particle node at `node_path` in the editor for `duration` seconds.

tools.name: particle.convert_cpu_to_gpu
tools.description: Converts the CPUParticles node at `node_path` into the equivalent GPUParticles node, returning the new node path.

tools.name: navigation.bake_mesh
tools.description: Bakes the navigation mesh under the NavigationRegion at `nav_region_path`.

tools.name: navigation.add_agent
tools.description: Adds a NavigationAgent under `parent_path` configured by `params`.

tools.name: navigation.set_avoidance
tools.description: Toggles avoidance on the agent at `node_path`.

tools.name: navigation.configure_layers
tools.description: Atomically applies the navigation layer name map declared in `layers` (`{layer_index: name}`).

tools.name: navigation.find_path
tools.description: Returns a navigation path from `from` to `to`. When `optimize` is true, the path is post-processed for shortcuts.

tools.name: navigation.debug_draw
tools.description: Enables or disables navigation debug drawing.

tools.name: audio.list_buses
tools.description: Returns every audio bus and its current volume.

tools.name: audio.set_bus_volume_db
tools.description: Sets the audio bus `bus_name` volume to `db`.

tools.name: audio.add_bus_effect
tools.description: Adds an effect of type `effect_type` (e.g. "Reverb", "Delay") to the bus `bus_name` and returns the new effect index.

tools.name: audio.import_sound
tools.description: Imports the audio file at `source_path` to `target_path` with the supplied `import_flags`.

tools.name: audio.play_stream
tools.description: Plays the audio stream at `stream_path`. Returns a unique `player_id` for later control.

tools.name: audio.stop_stream
tools.description: Stops the audio player previously started by `audio.play_stream`.

tools.name: animation_tree.create
tools.description: Creates an AnimationTree under `parent_path` bound to `anim_player_path` for state-machine driven animation.

tools.name: animation_tree.set_parameter
tools.description: Sets the AnimationTree parameter `param` to `value`.

tools.name: animation_tree.get_parameters
tools.description: Returns every parameter currently exposed by the AnimationTree.

tools.name: animation_tree.set_active
tools.description: Toggles the AnimationTree at `tree_path` active or inactive.

tools.name: state_machine.list_states
tools.description: Returns the list of states for the AnimationNodeStateMachine identified by `(tree_path, playback_param)`.

tools.name: state_machine.travel
tools.description: Requests the state machine to travel to `state_name`.

tools.name: state_machine.get_current
tools.description: Returns the current state of the state machine.

tools.name: blend_tree.configure_node
tools.description: Configures the blend tree node identified by `node_id` to be a `type` (e.g. "blend2", "blend_space_1d") with `params`.

tools.name: export.list_presets
tools.description: Lists every export preset configured in `export_presets.cfg`.

tools.name: export.run_preset
tools.description: Runs the export preset `preset_name`, writing the artifact to `output_path`. When `debug` is true, exports a debug build.

tools.name: export.validate_preset
tools.description: Validates the export preset `preset_name` and returns warnings plus any blocking errors.

tools.name: android.list_devices
tools.description: Returns every Android device currently visible to `adb`.

tools.name: android.install_apk
tools.description: Installs the APK at `apk_path` to the device matching `device_serial`. Defaults to the only attached device.

tools.name: android.run_logcat
tools.description: Captures `adb logcat` lines, optionally filtered by `filter` and limited to `duration_ms` of capture time.

tools.name: batch.dry_run
tools.description: Runs the same dispatcher pipeline as `batch.execute` without applying changes. Returns the would-be results.

tools.name: batch.execute
tools.description: Executes the supplied list of `{tool, params}` operations. When `transactional` is true, all ops succeed atomically or roll back.

tools.name: editor.clear_output
tools.description: Clears the editor Output dock.

tools.name: editor.focus_node
tools.description: Focuses the SceneTree dock on `node_path`.

tools.name: editor.get_errors
tools.description: Returns every active editor error or warning, with file, line, message, and severity.

tools.name: editor.get_output_log
tools.description: Returns the most recent editor output log lines.

tools.name: editor.get_selection
tools.description: Returns the currently selected node paths in the editor.

tools.name: editor.get_undo_stack
tools.description: Returns the most recent undo stack entries, capped by `max`.

tools.name: editor.redo
tools.description: Redoes the most recently undone action.

tools.name: editor.set_selection
tools.description: Replaces the editor selection with `node_paths`.

tools.name: editor.undo
tools.description: Undoes the last editor action and returns whether anything was undone plus the action name.

tools.name: gdscript.save_with_validation
tools.description: Validates `source` and, when valid, writes it to `path`. Reload is requested in the editor on success.

tools.name: gdscript.validate
tools.description: Compiles GDScript `source` and returns whether parsing succeeded plus a list of `{line, col, msg}` diagnostics.

tools.name: node.call_method
tools.description: Invokes the runtime method `method` on `node_path` with the positional arguments in `args`.

tools.name: node.connect_signal
tools.description: Connects `signal` from `from_path` to `method` on `to_path`. `flags` mirrors Godot `Object.CONNECT_*` constants.

tools.name: node.disconnect_signal
tools.description: Disconnects the connection identified by `(from_path, signal, to_path, method)`.

tools.name: node.duplicate
tools.description: Duplicates the node at `node_path`. `flags` mirrors Godot `Node.DUPLICATE_*` constants (signals, scripts, instancing).

tools.name: node.find_by_name
tools.description: Returns every node whose name matches `name`. When `regex` is true, `name` is treated as a regular expression.

tools.name: node.find_by_type
tools.description: Returns every node whose Godot type matches `type`, optionally starting from `root` instead of the scene root.

tools.name: node.get_properties
tools.description: Returns every readable property on `node_path`, optionally filtered by a name pattern (`filter`).

tools.name: node.get_property
tools.description: Returns the current value of `property` on `node_path`.

tools.name: node.get_signals
tools.description: Lists every signal exposed by the node at `node_path`.

tools.name: node.remove
tools.description: Removes the node at `node_path` inside `scene_path`.

tools.name: node.rename
tools.description: Renames the node at `node_path` to `new_name`.

tools.name: node.reparent
tools.description: Reparents `node_path` under `new_parent_path`.

tools.name: refactor.find_unused_assets
tools.description: Returns every asset under `root` (default: project root) that no scene or script references.

tools.name: refactor.move_file
tools.description: Moves a file from `from` to `to`. When `update_refs` is true, every reference is rewritten as well.

tools.name: refactor.organize_imports
tools.description: Reorders `preload`/`load`/`extends` imports in the file at `path`.

tools.name: refactor.rename_class
tools.description: Renames `old_name` class to `new_name` everywhere.

tools.name: refactor.rename_method
tools.description: Renames `old` method on `class_name` to `new`.

tools.name: resource.apply_fix
tools.description: Applies the supplied `fix` patch to the Resource at `path`. Returns whether the fix was applied and the canonical path.

tools.name: resource.duplicate
tools.description: Duplicates the Resource at `from` to `to`. Optional `transform` lets the caller patch fields during the copy.

tools.name: resource.inspect
tools.description: Inspects the Resource at `path`, returning declared fields plus `issues[]` from the bound `validate()` method and a suggested fix.

tools.name: resource.list_by_type
tools.description: Returns every Resource whose `class_name` matches the requested class, optionally constrained to `root` and below.

tools.name: resource.load
tools.description: Loads the Resource at `path` and returns its declared `type` plus a flat `fields` mapping.

tools.name: resource.save
